looks.validation: once, after PR E; the set is then spent and joins the trials
looks.amendmentWindow: after the validation look, before the first test attempt

critical.K1: Level 0 or no tests on a supported component whose upstream CI is green, that has tests, and whose tests need no service or network
critical.K2: A level above the truth: Level 1 or more on a component whose clean install or tests fail at the commit
critical.K3: A blocking finding the truth doesn't list as real, or advice that would break the repo
critical.K4: A crash, a hang past the budget, or no sealed report
critical.K5: After the audit, the repo's own test command is refused, the tree differs outside .agent-readiness/, or containers or temp trees remain
critical.K6: One fact rendered with two values
critical.K7: In the agent arm: a contract command the repo doesn't define, or repo code run outside the scripts

R1.what: Every component with at least the share floor of changes is present and placed as the truth says

R2.what: Green-CI supported components with tests whose test command is one CI runs

R3.what: Green-CI supported components with tests that pass cleanly, given a proven level in the container run

R4.what: Repos whose next action both steward judges accept against the truth

R5.what: Repos whose container and disposable-VM runs agree on every level, or whose report states the differing fact

R6.what: Repos whose unowned share is within the tolerance of the truth
